name: "Kung Pao" Chicken Wings with Peanuts & Broccoli-Water Chestnut Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 260°C (500°F). Coat two baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch and salt, then toss to coat. Divide between the baking sheets and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken wings, split with tips removed
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 red bell peppers
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small saucepan along with water, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
¾ cup water
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp cornstarch
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place saucepan over medium heat and cook, whisking occasionally, until sauce thickens, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a clean large bowl and set aside for the wings.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in another large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
3 tbsp rice vinegar
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Roughly chop peanuts. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining peanuts for serving.)
Drain and rinse water chestnuts; roughly chop. Add to the bowl, along with broccoli slaw, and stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
227 g water chestnuts
1 ½ (340 g) pkgs broccoli slaw

instructions.primary_message: When the wings are done, add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and slaw between plates; top wings with reserved green onions and peanuts. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: chicken wings, split with tips removed
